item.title: Mitsu no Saimin
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: #define
  • 発売日: 2014-01-04
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (48 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 3つの催眠
  • 英語名: Mitsu no Saimin

别名

  • 三つの催眠

あらすじ

Hirayama Shigeru is given a devilish book that grants him the power of mind control.

After practicing how to use it and enslaving his classmate Kujou Chiharu, he faces another girl, Takamihara Mina, and makes a bet with her:

If she can figure out the three commands he has hidden in her, he will relinquish his mind control and free those he has enslaved.

item.title: Saimin Jikken
item.description:

  • ブランド: #define
  • 発売日: 2009-04-17
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (66 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠実験
  • 英語名: Saimin Jikken

别名

  • Saimin Jikken

あらすじ

The son at the temple, Kazuma Fukagawa, developed a strong interest in hypnotism by a sheer accident.

Kazuma tried it on with the classmates. He figured that would be a great way to take a break from the daily temple training.

His partners were cute girls, Senka and Momoka. He liked them secretly.

item.title: Minami kara no Tegami
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: #define
  • 発売日: 2007-12-20
  • スコア: 6.26/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ミナミからの手紙
  • 英語名: Minami kara no Tegami

别名

  • A letter from Minami

あらすじ

Kusanagi Kazushi, our main character, steps bravely into the world of online dating websites half out of curiosity and half out of other motives…

It is there that he meets a girl. But when he talks to her, he gets a strange feeling…

And as the distance between them grows shorter, that feeling begins to turn into clear suspicion.

item.title: M.C. -trois-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: #define
  • 発売日: 2005-05-15
  • スコア: 6.6/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: M.C. -trois-
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

One day, the protagonist discover an old note about hypnosis experiments.

He is surprised to see that along a keyword to put the subjects in hypnotic state, there’s the name of his female teacher.

After asking her about hypnosis and asking her to try to remember how it could feel, he pronounce the words.

From there, will he try to make her a lover, or a slave?
